_comment: Central tweakables for a run. max_posting_age_days: drop postings older than this many days (by their posted date); set to 0 or null to keep all ages. Postings with an unknown date are always kept. fit_scoring_enabled: master off-switch for the Anthropic API — set false to skip all LLM fit scoring (e.g. test runs), regardless of ANTHROPIC_API_KEY. star_within_days: mark postings newer than this many days with a star in the report; 0/null disables the star. allow_international_remote: when false (default), remote roles whose location names a non-US country (e.g. 'United Kingdom - Remote') are dropped; set true to keep all remote roles regardless of country. remote_search.enabled: master switch for the US-remote lane (reads remote_companies.json, runs profiles with remote_search:true against a US-remote gate).
